structural_change: NEW face cluster (Q-DIE11-COLL 10-18, HANDOFF 0ea item 3; bank137 CLOSED b1-533c4162e): first hardened face of the compute-die io_collective (qfd_collective_static_io_production -> qfd_collective_static_io -> 5 x qfd_coll_static_face). SerDes1 profile FW546 PHY339 L376 R0 PEER_R0, TOK_REG=1 (opt-in core-side face pin registers on cal_ck, compensated calendar; default 0 keeps the production face byte-identical). Hard children: 2 x closed qfd_static_ch546 (TX/RX static CDC), 4 x qfd_coll_bank137 (codec banks). Own CTS roots cal_ck (core calendar + pin regs), cal_lck and codec_ck[0] (link calendar, codec control = the SerDes PHY FDI clock on the die, trunk clk_serdes<s>); entries tx_wck/rx_rck (core) and tx_rck/rx_wck/codec_ck[1..4] (link) clock only their children. A multiple_cts_roots leaf (gate a3b6f888e) is impossible: CTS roots must reach only standard-cell clock pins and every CDC/bank root also clocks a macro.
